 profile=json.loads(gzip.decompress(path.read_bytes()));nodes={n['id']:n for n in profile['nodes']};parents={c:n['id']for n in profile['nodes']for c in n.get('children',[])};row=None

  for r in json.loads(p.read_text()):
   if path.name==f"{r['level']}-{r['side']}.cpuprofile.gz":row=r

 f=row['performance'];clock=f['missionFrames']or f['warFrames']or f['chargeFrames'];i=max(range(len(f['frames'])),key=lambda i:f['frames'][i]);maximum=dict(index=i,ms=f['frames'][i],**clock[i]);offset=profile['performanceStartedAt']-f['startedAt'];t=0;self=collections.Counter();inc=collections.Counter();peak=collections.Counter();handover=collections.Counter()
 for sample,dt in zip(profile['samples'],profile['timeDeltas']):
  t+=dt/1000;n=sample;chain=[];self[n]+=dt/1000

   if at-100<=t+offset<=at+1500:handover[tuple(chain[:16])]+=dt/1000
 def frame(n):return nodes[n]['callFrame']

 rows.append(dict(sourceRevision=sourceRun['revision'],path=str(path),sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),side=row['side'],level=row['level'],tier=row['tier'],profileSamples=len(profile['samples']),profileDurationMs=(profile['endTime']-profile['startTime'])/1000,maximum=maximum,longTasks=f.get('longTasks',[]),topSelf=top(self),topInclusive=top(inc),maximumStacks=stacks(peak),handoverStacks=stacks(handover)))
(R/'cpu-attribution.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
for r in rows:print(r['side'],r['level'],r['tier'],'max',r['maximum'],'long tasks',r['longTasks'],'peak',[(x['stack'][0]['functionName'],x['ms'])for x in r['maximumStacks'][:6]])
